desc: Establish that cost = sum(U)+sum(D) - N*H and feasibility is exactly H <= U_i + D_j + X*|i-j| for all pairs (necessity via Lipschitz and bounds; sufficiency via f_i = max_j(L_j - X*|i-j|), L_j = max(0, H-D_j)).
Implement the direct O(N) pairwise-min formula H_max = min_{i,j}(U_i + D_j + X*|i-j|) via two linear scans, output sum(U)+sum(D) - N*H_max, reading stdin and writing stdout.
Verify the implementation against all 4 provided samples.
Confirm the two linear scans correctly cover all ordered pairs including i=j (pass 1 handles i<=j, pass 2 handles i>=j).
